profile_context_artifacts.note: Per-row path and changed-line presence is derived from exact new-revision dependency lists, preprocessed line markers, and the recorded old/new Git diff. Presence is not semantic reachability proof.

new_profile_product_action_census.semantic_limit: A compile database entry proves GN exported a source compile action for this new profile. It does not prove the action ran, that a changed line is active, that a modeled path reaches it, or that the old profile used the same action.

old_revision_manifest_candidate_audit.conclusion: No exact old Ark commit pin was found in the bounded candidate refs. The v5.0.3 release snapshot does pin HiHope board/vendor, but its Ark commit differs and is not the old commit's descendant; it is not a profile-matched old revision. A matching historical product manifest/profile remains unresolved.

full_manifest_history_audit.scope_limit: All refs advertised by the recorded GitCode remote at capture time and their reachable history; third-party and unadvertised/unreachable refs are outside scope.

all_old_ark_manifest_pin_audit.scope_limit: unadvertised or unreachable server objects and third-party manifest repositories

blockers: The generated build graph reports duplicate-output warnings and the full Ninja graph query remains blocked at Contacts_DataAbility.stamp; full product build is not established.
The source archive omits 19 nested gitlink commit trees; only 16 of the 19 have a parent .gitmodules URL. The exact vendor/ohemu/common/qemu-run linkfile source is missing.

A full-history audit of all 10,315 refs advertised by the recorded GitCode manifest remote found no exact old Ark commit pin in 10,420 reachable commits; third-party and unadvertised/unreachable refs remain outside scope. The nearest HiHope v5.0.3 snapshot pins a different, non-descendant Ark commit; no matching old product profile is established. The new-revision compile database lists source actions but does not prove action execution or old/new semantic IR/CFG equivalence.
